name: Saikawa Suzu
source:
A second-year student at Seishin Academy. She has a serious and inflexible personality as a member of the public morals committee. She believes that the work of a sex instructor and a public morals officer are naturally conflicting. She constantly complains to her teachers about it....

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page012.html]official site[/url]]
